gloss: to warn; to admonish; to caution

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {戒|いまし}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to warn; to admonish; to caution
definitions.explanation: To strongly advise someone against doing something wrong or dangerous, often from a position of authority or experience.

definitions.gloss: to discipline; to punish as a lesson
definitions.explanation: To impose a consequence or correction on someone so they learn from their mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{戒|いまし}めた。
⟦{油断|ゆだん}しない→油断する：25389_yudansuru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{戒|いまし}めた。
examples.english: I cautioned myself not to let my guard down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}をつかない→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{戒|いまし}めて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father always admonished me not to tell lies.

examples.english: I engrave past failures in my heart as a lesson.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal verb used for serious warnings or moral guidance. Often used when a superior warns a subordinate, or when reflecting on one's own behavior. The noun form ⟦{戒|いまし}め→戒め：20179_imashime⟧ means "warning" or "lesson."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{戒|いまし}める (to caution oneself)
- ⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{戒|いまし}める (to sternly admonish)
- ⟦{戒|いまし}め→戒め：20179_imashime⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (words of warning)
- ⟦{戒|いまし}め→戒め：20179_imashime⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take as a lesson)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to warn, to be careful — more everyday and less authoritative
- ⟦{叱|しか}る→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧: to scold — focuses on expressing anger at wrongdoing
- ⟦{諭|さと}す→諭す：14223_satosu⟧: to admonish gently — calmer and more patient than {戒|いまし}める
